note: Every installed copy reads this file before checking for updates, then looks for releases in whatever repo 'repo' names. It points at the public releases repo because the updater is two anonymous HTTPS gets with no credentials, so every repo it touches must be public — and a GitHub release inherits its repo's visibility, so private source means the binaries live elsewhere. This copy is the master: CI pushes it to the releases repo on every release, and builds from 0.40.0 on read it from there. The copy in the source repo is the rescue lane for older builds, which still look here first; it only works while this repo is public.
noticeHowTo: 'notice' puts one line of text in front of every running copy WITHOUT shipping a release — the only channel to a copy that is not going to take an update. Set 'notice' to the message, 'noticeId' to a short unique tag for it (e.g. 'going-private-2026-08'), and optionally 'noticeUrl' to an https link the dialog offers to open. Each copy shows a given noticeId once and then never again, so change the id to say something new and leave it alone to stop nagging. Empty 'notice' shows nothing. Keep it to a sentence or two: it is rendered as plain text, never as markup, and long messages are truncated at 400 characters.
noticeSupportedFrom: 0.51.0 — READ THIS BEFORE RELYING ON IT. Builds older than 0.51.0 do not read 'notice' at all; the field was described here long before anything implemented it. A notice therefore reaches 0.51.0 and newer only, and can never reach a copy that has not updated to it. To reach older copies there is exactly one lever: publish a release while this repo is still public and wait for them to take it.
portableRetiredRemoved: The switch that could retire the portable build is gone as of 0.55.0, code and all. The machines the portable build exists for are the ones nobody is allowed to install software on, so retiring it there does not upgrade anybody — it removes the app and offers a remedy they cannot run. If the portable build is ever finished with, stop building it; that reaches nobody who still depends on the copy they have. Setting portableRetired here now does nothing at all.
